Mother Courage and Her Children

Much Ado About Nothing

11 June - 24 October
In sun-soaked Messina, sharp tongues, short tempers and savage gossip collide in an unfiltered rom-com about secrets, status and second chances.

17 July - 13 September

DISCOVER MORE

CLIMATE ACTION

Climate Open House

We’re opening our great oak doors for our first Climate Open House, as part of London Climate Action Week this June. Join us for a free day of discovery, with performances, events and activities taking place around Shakespeare’s Globe.

Discover More

Off-Grid Performance

Join us on 28 June for this special performance during London Climate Action Week, as the Globe Theatre goes off-grid. We’re switching off and returning to our Shakespearean roots, exploring how we can move toward a low-energy production.

Discover More

RESEARCH EVENTS

Research in Action: Staging Eloquence, Silence and Disability in University Drama

12 May
Join us in the Sam Wanamaker Playhouse for an exploration of how early modern universities staged speech-based disability in their Latin plays.
Info & Tickets
Sam Wanamaker Playhouse

Research in Action: Editing in Action
